blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解 PDA TR-68 的起源背景與 2024 年修訂版的核心更新方向，掌握其與 ICH Q9(R1) 及 ICH Q12 的關聯性。
blocks.en: Understand the origin of PDA TR-68 and the core direction of the 2024 revision, and grasp its links to ICH Q9(R1) and ICH Q12.

blocks.zh: 描述自 2000 年代以來全球藥品短缺問題加劇的多因素根本原因，並辨識美國 FDA 及歐洲 EMA 的監管因應措施。
blocks.en: Describe the multifactorial root causes behind the worsening of global drug shortages since the 2000s, and identify the regulatory responses of the US FDA and the European EMA.

blocks.zh: 說明 TR-68 的適用範圍——從製造到「移交第一經濟客戶」的完整供應鏈，以及超出範圍的部分（通路端短缺）。
blocks.en: Explain the scope of TR-68: the full supply chain from manufacturing to "handover to the first economic customer", and what falls outside scope (shortages arising downstream in distribution).

blocks.zh: 熟悉本報告提供的三項核心工具：風險基礎框架、風險分流模型（Risk Triage Model）、以及藥品短缺風險登錄冊（Risk Register）範本。
blocks.en: Become familiar with the three core tools this report provides: the risk-based framework, the Risk Triage Model, and the Drug Shortage Risk Register template.

blocks.zh: 掌握第 2.0 節所有關鍵術語的精確定義，並能區辨「藥品短缺」、「潛在藥品短缺」、「重大短缺」與「剩餘風險」等概念的差異。
blocks.en: Master the precise definitions of all key terms in Section 2.0, and be able to distinguish concepts such as "drug shortage", "potential drug shortage", "critical shortage" and "residual risk".

blocks.zh: 1.0Introduction  |  導論
blocks.en: 1.0Introduction

blocks.zh: 中文導讀 Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：TR-68 是什麼？
blocks.en: Core concept: What is TR-68?

blocks.zh: PDA Technical Report No. 68（TR-68）是由製藥業領導協會 PDA（Parenteral Drug Association）所發布的技術指引，聚焦於「藥品短缺的預防與管理」。
blocks.en: PDA Technical Report No. 68 (TR-68) is a technical report published by the Parenteral Drug Association (PDA), the pharmaceutical industry's leading association, focused on "prevention and management of drug shortages".

blocks.zh: 首版：2014 年，回應 EMA（歐洲藥品管理局）對製造/品質導致藥品短缺的議題。
blocks.en: First edition: 2014, written in response to the EMA's (European Medicines Agency's) concern about drug shortages caused by manufacturing and quality issues.

blocks.zh: 2024 修訂版：納入 ICH Q9(R1)（品質風險管理）與 ICH Q12（產品生命週期管理）的最新監管框架。
blocks.en: 2024 revision: incorporates the latest regulatory frameworks of ICH Q9(R1) (Quality Risk Management) and ICH Q12 (Product Lifecycle Management).

blocks.zh: 核心方法不變：風險基礎（risk-based）的預防與緩解方法仍是主軸。
blocks.en: Core approach unchanged: the risk-based approach to prevention and mitigation remains the backbone.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：預防勝於治療
blocks.en: Real-life analogy: prevention is better than cure

blocks.zh: 想像藥品短缺就像醫院的「急診室爆滿」——平時若有良好的預防性健康管理（風險控制），急診需求自然降低。TR-68 的精神正是：在問題發生之前，就建立系統性的風險識別與預防機制，而非等短缺發生後才緊急應變。
blocks.en: Think of a drug shortage as an overcrowded hospital emergency room. With good preventive health management in normal times (risk control), emergency demand naturally falls. The spirit of TR-68 is exactly this: build a systematic mechanism for risk identification and prevention before problems occur, rather than scrambling to respond after a shortage has already happened.

blocks.zh: 重點：ICH Q9(R1) 對「危害」的新定義
blocks.en: Key point: the new ICH Q9(R1) definition of "harm"

blocks.zh: ICH Q9(R1) 將「危害（harm）」定義為：「對健康的損害，包括因產品品質或可用性喪失所導致的損害。」
blocks.en: ICH Q9(R1) defines "harm" as: "damage to health, including damage that can occur from loss of product quality or availability."

blocks.zh: 這是重大轉變——過去「harm」主要指品質缺陷，新定義明確將「缺貨/供應中斷」也納入危害範疇，直接將藥品短缺問題提升為品質風險管理的核心議題。
blocks.en: This is a major shift. In the past, "harm" mainly meant quality defects; the new definition explicitly brings stock-outs and supply interruptions into the scope of harm, directly elevating drug shortages to a core topic of quality risk management.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Discussion question

blocks.zh: TR-68 最初是在回應哪個監管機構的哪項倡議？2024 年修訂版新增了哪兩項 ICH 指引作為對齊基準？
blocks.en: Which regulatory agency's initiative was TR-68 originally written in response to? Which two ICH guidelines were added in the 2024 revision as alignment benchmarks?

blocks.zh: 1.1Background  |  背景
blocks.en: 1.1Background

blocks.zh: 核心概念：藥品短缺的多因素根源
blocks.en: Core concept: the multifactorial roots of drug shortages

blocks.zh: 自 2000 年代初期起，全球藥品短缺問題逐漸惡化，原因是「多因素（multifactorial）」的，主要包括：
blocks.en: Since the early 2000s, global drug shortages have steadily worsened. The causes are "multifactorial" and mainly include:

blocks.zh: 財務與商業因素：低利潤藥品被廠商放棄生產
blocks.en: Financial and commercial factors: low-margin drugs are abandoned by manufacturers

blocks.zh: 供應鏈全球化：API（活性藥品成分）高度集中在少數國家製造
blocks.en: Globalization of the supply chain: APIs (active pharmaceutical ingredients) are concentrated in a small number of countries

blocks.zh: 法規要求演進：GMP 合規標準日益嚴格，導致廠商停產或召回
blocks.en: Evolving regulatory requirements: increasingly strict GMP compliance standards lead manufacturers to cease production or recall products

blocks.zh: 需求突增：如 COVID-19 疫情期間的非預期需求
blocks.en: Demand surges: for example, unexpected demand during the COVID-19 pandemic

blocks.zh: 產能不足與缺乏備援：單一廠址、單一來源的脆弱架構
blocks.en: Insufficient capacity and lack of backup: fragile structures built on a single site and a single source

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：供應鏈就像水管網絡
blocks.en: Real-life analogy: the supply chain as a water pipe network

blocks.zh: 全球製藥供應鏈就像一個錯綜複雜的城市水管網絡。全球化使管線越鋪越長、越交錯越複雜，任何一段管線的破裂（製造問題、法規查廠）都可能影響下游整個城市（患者）的供水。
blocks.en: The global pharmaceutical supply chain is like the intricate water pipe network of a big city. Globalization has made the pipes longer and more intertwined, so a rupture in any one section (a manufacturing problem, a regulatory inspection) can affect water supply to the entire downstream city (the patients).

blocks.zh: ICH Q9(R1) 特別指出：供應鏈多樣性雖可提升可用性，但過度複雜的供應鏈反而會引入系統性風險，這是一個值得警惕的悖論。
blocks.en: ICH Q9(R1) specifically points out that although supply chain diversity can improve availability, an overly complex supply chain can instead introduce systemic risk, a paradox worth keeping in mind.

blocks.zh: 重點：MAH 高層管理的責任
blocks.en: Key point: the responsibility of MAH senior management

blocks.zh: TR-68 明確指出：行銷授權持有人（MAH，Marketing Authorization Holder）的高層管理對確保產品不間斷供應負有直接責任，其決策不僅影響短缺發生的可能性，也決定了從短缺中恢復的速度。
blocks.en: TR-68 states clearly that the senior management of the Marketing Authorization Holder (MAH) bears direct responsibility for ensuring uninterrupted supply of the product. Its decisions affect not only the likelihood of a shortage but also how quickly the supply recovers from one.

blocks.zh: 這不只是 QA 部門的問題，而是企業治理層級的核心義務。
blocks.en: This is not only a QA department issue but a core obligation at the level of corporate governance.

blocks.zh: 關鍵統計數據（2023 美國參院報告）
blocks.en: Key statistics (2023 US Senate report)

blocks.zh: 2021–2022 年間，活躍藥品短缺案例增加 30%
blocks.en: Between 2021 and 2022, active drug shortages increased by 30%

blocks.zh: 短缺持續時間平均延長 1.5 年
blocks.en: The average duration of shortages lengthened by 1.5 years

blocks.zh: 過度依賴境外資源被認定為國家安全風險
blocks.en: Overdependence on overseas sources was identified as a national security risk

blocks.zh: FDA 與業界均缺乏端對端供應鏈可視性
blocks.en: Both FDA and industry lack end-to-end supply chain visibility

blocks.zh: 根據本節背景，請列舉三個不屬於「製造或品質問題」的藥品短缺根本原因。為什麼 TR-68 強調需要多方利害關係人（multistakeholder）的協作才能解決短缺問題？
blocks.en: Based on this section's background, list three root causes of drug shortage that are not "manufacturing or quality problems". Why does TR-68 stress that a multistakeholder collaboration is needed to solve drug shortages?

blocks.zh: 1.2Purpose and Scope  |  目的與範圍
blocks.en: 1.2Purpose and Scope

blocks.zh: 核心概念：TR-68 的適用範圍邊界
blocks.en: Core concept: the scope boundary of TR-68

blocks.zh: TR-68 的適用範圍有明確的「終止點」：
blocks.en: The scope of TR-68 has a clear "end point":

blocks.zh: 範圍內（In Scope）：從製造開始，到「移交第一經濟客戶（handover to the first economic customer）」為止，即批次放行（batch release）到移交批發商/經銷商
blocks.en: In scope: from the start of manufacturing to "handover to the first economic customer", i.e. from batch release to handover to the wholesaler/distributor

blocks.zh: 範圍外（Out of Scope）：移交後在配銷通路、藥局、醫院內發生的短缺
blocks.en: Out of scope: shortages that arise after handover, within the distribution channel, pharmacies and hospitals

blocks.zh: 例外情況：若 MAH 自行負責配銷，則範圍可延伸至配銷環節
blocks.en: Exception: if the MAH is itself responsible for distribution, the scope can extend to the distribution step

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：餐廳廚房 vs. 外送平台
blocks.en: Real-life analogy: restaurant kitchen vs. delivery platform

blocks.zh: TR-68 就像一份「餐廳廚房管理規範」——它管控從食材採購、烹飪到出餐（批次放行）的品質與供應穩定性。但一旦餐點交給外送員（移交第一經濟客戶），外送過程中的問題就不在本規範範圍內。
blocks.en: TR-68 is like a "restaurant kitchen management code": it governs quality and supply stability from ingredient purchasing and cooking to serving the dish (batch release). But once the meal is handed to the delivery rider (handover to the first economic customer), problems during delivery fall outside this code.

blocks.zh: 當然，若餐廳自己也負責外送，那外送流程也就落入管理範圍了。
blocks.en: Of course, if the restaurant also does its own delivery, the delivery process then falls within scope.

blocks.zh: 法規依據：通報義務
blocks.en: Regulatory basis: notification obligations

blocks.zh: TR-68 框架協助 MAH 履行以下通報義務：
blocks.en: The TR-68 framework helps the MAH meet the following notification obligations:

blocks.zh: 美國：《聯邦食品、藥品和化妝品法》第 506C 條——須向 FDA 通報潛在短缺
blocks.en: United States: Section 506C of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act: potential shortages must be notified to FDA

blocks.zh: 歐盟：EU 指令 2003/94/EC 第 13 條——須向相關主管機關通報
blocks.en: European Union: Article 13 of EU Directive 2003/94/EC: notification of the relevant competent authority is required

blocks.zh: 早期通報已被證實能有效降低短缺件數，使製造商與主管機關有時間共同採取預防措施。
blocks.en: Early notification has been shown to reduce the number of shortages effectively, giving manufacturers and authorities time to take preventive measures together.

blocks.zh: 相關 PDA 技術報告
blocks.en: Related PDA Technical Reports

blocks.zh: TR-54：品質風險管理在製藥生產中的實施指引（QRM 實施細節）
blocks.en: TR-54: guidance on implementing quality risk management in pharmaceutical manufacturing (QRM implementation details)

blocks.zh: TR-59：統計方法在生產監控中的應用（提供額外的風險基礎活動）
blocks.en: TR-59: application of statistical methods in manufacturing monitoring (provides additional risk-based activities)

blocks.zh: TR-68 是這個風險管理工具家族的重要成員，專注於供應可靠性議題。
blocks.en: TR-68 is an important member of this family of risk management tools, focusing on the issue of supply reliability.

blocks.zh: 假設一家 MAH 同時負責藥品製造與配銷至醫院。TR-68 的框架在這種情況下適用到哪個環節？如果一家 MAH 將配銷完全委託給第三方批發商，則 TR-68 的適用範圍止於何處？
blocks.en: Suppose an MAH is responsible for both manufacturing and distribution of a drug to hospitals. To which step does the TR-68 framework apply in this case? If an MAH fully outsources distribution to a third-party wholesaler, where does the scope of TR-68 end?

blocks.zh: 實際應用：識別工具需求
blocks.en: Practical application: identifying tool needs

blocks.zh: 在您的組織中，以下哪項工具目前已存在？哪項尚未建立？
blocks.en: In your organization, which of the following tools already exist, and which have not yet been established?

blocks.zh: 針對特定產品的供應鏈風險評估文件
blocks.en: Product-specific supply chain risk assessment documents

blocks.zh: 藥品短缺風險登錄冊（Risk Register）
blocks.en: Drug Shortage Risk Register

blocks.zh: 藥品短缺預防與應變計畫（Prevention & Response Plan）
blocks.en: Drug Shortage Prevention & Response Plan

blocks.zh: 潛在短缺的內部通報機制
blocks.en: Internal notification mechanism for potential shortages

blocks.zh: TR-68 提供的三項核心工具
blocks.en: The three core tools provided by TR-68

blocks.zh: 本報告的「目的與範圍」明確提供三個層次的實用工具：
blocks.en: The "Purpose and Scope" of this report explicitly provides practical tools at three levels:

blocks.zh: 2.0Glossary and Abbreviations  |  術語與縮寫
blocks.en: 2.0Glossary and Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 中文術語解說 Glossary Commentary
blocks.en: Glossary Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：TR-68 術語體系概覽
blocks.en: Core concept: overview of the TR-68 terminology system

blocks.zh: 本節 18 個術語構成 TR-68 的語意基礎，可按功能分為四大群組：
blocks.en: The 18 terms in this section form the semantic foundation of TR-68 and can be divided by function into four groups:

blocks.zh: 藥品分類：Critical Medicine、Medically Necessary Drug、Life Supporting/Sustaining Drug
blocks.en: Drug classification: Critical Medicine, Medically Necessary Drug, Life Supporting/Sustaining Drug

blocks.zh: 短缺類型：Drug Shortage、Critical Shortage、Potential Drug Shortage、Meaningful Disruption
blocks.en: Shortage types: Drug Shortage, Critical Shortage, Potential Drug Shortage, Meaningful Disruption

blocks.zh: 風險管理工具：QRM、Risk、Residual Risk、Risk Triage、Risk Priority Level
blocks.en: Risk management tools: QRM, Risk, Residual Risk, Risk Triage, Risk Priority Level

blocks.zh: 管理文件：Risk Register、Prevention & Response Plan、Value Stream Map
blocks.en: Management documents: Risk Register, Prevention & Response Plan, Value Stream Map

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：三種藥品重要性層次
blocks.en: Real-life analogy: three levels of drug importance

blocks.zh: 想像一個醫院的藥品清單：
blocks.en: Imagine a hospital's drug list:

blocks.zh: Critical Medicine（關鍵藥品）：考量治療適應症、替代治療可及性、供應鏈脆弱性。例如：抗生素、化療藥物。
blocks.en: Critical Medicine: considers the therapeutic indication, availability of alternative treatments and supply chain vulnerability. Examples: antibiotics, chemotherapy drugs.

blocks.zh: Medically Necessary Drug（醫療必要藥品）：治療或預防嚴重疾病，且無合適替代品。例如：某些罕見病用藥。
blocks.en: Medically Necessary Drug: treats or prevents a serious disease and has no suitable alternative. Examples: certain drugs for rare diseases.

blocks.zh: Life Supporting/Sustaining Drug（維生藥品）：缺少此藥，患者的基本生理功能將中斷。例如：胰島素、呼吸器用藥。
blocks.en: Life Supporting/Sustaining Drug: without it, the patient's basic physiological functions would be interrupted. Examples: insulin, drugs used with respirators.

blocks.zh: 越往後，短缺的緊迫性越高，監管通報與緩解措施的優先順序也越高。
blocks.en: The further down the list, the greater the urgency of a shortage, and the higher the priority of regulatory notification and mitigation measures.

blocks.zh: 重點辨析：「藥品短缺」的四個關鍵元素
blocks.en: Key distinction: the four key elements of "drug shortage"

blocks.zh: TR-68 對「Drug Shortage（藥品短缺）」的定義包含四個必須理解的子元素：
blocks.en: The TR-68 definition of "Drug Shortage" contains four sub-elements that must be understood:

blocks.zh: Shortage（短缺本身）：識別目前、即將發生或預期的供應中斷
blocks.en: Shortage (the shortage itself): identifies a current, imminent or anticipated supply interruption

blocks.zh: Supply（供應）：MAH 投放市場的總存量
blocks.en: Supply: the total stock the MAH places on the market

blocks.zh: Demand（需求）：醫療專業人員/患者基於臨床需要的請求；需在正確時間、足夠數量下獲得
blocks.en: Demand: requests from healthcare professionals/patients based on clinical need; the product must be available at the right time and in sufficient quantity

blocks.zh: National level（國家層級）：在全國層面供不應求；地區性物流問題（如配送困難）不算藥品短缺
blocks.en: National level: supply falls short of demand at the national level; regional logistics problems (such as delivery difficulties) are not a drug shortage

blocks.zh: 重點辨析：Meaningful Disruption vs. 一般停產
blocks.en: Key distinction: Meaningful Disruption vs. ordinary production stoppage

blocks.zh: 重大供應中斷（Meaningful Disruption） 需滿足：
blocks.en: A Meaningful Disruption must satisfy:

blocks.zh: 生產變更合理地可能導致供應明顯減少
blocks.en: A manufacturing change that is reasonably likely to lead to a significant reduction in supply

blocks.zh: 影響廠商的訂單履行能力或預期需求的供應
blocks.en: It affects the manufacturer's ability to fulfil orders or the supply to meet expected demand

blocks.zh: 不屬於 Meaningful Disruption：
blocks.en: The following are not a Meaningful Disruption:

blocks.zh: 例行維修保養（routine maintenance）
blocks.en: Routine maintenance

blocks.zh: 預計在短期內可恢復運作的細微生產調整
blocks.en: Minor production adjustments expected to be restored in the short term

blocks.zh: 這一定義直接影響廠商是否需要向 FDA 提交「早期通報」的義務觸發點。
blocks.en: This definition directly affects the trigger point for a manufacturer's obligation to submit "early notification" to FDA.

blocks.zh: 風險定義公式
blocks.en: Risk definition formula

blocks.zh: TR-68 沿用 ICH Q9(R1) 的風險定義：
blocks.en: TR-68 follows the ICH Q9(R1) definition of risk:

blocks.zh: 其中「危害（Harm）」= 健康損害，包括因產品品質或可用性喪失所致的損害
blocks.en: Here "Harm" = damage to health, including damage from loss of product quality or availability

blocks.zh: 「剩餘風險（Residual Risk）」= 實施風險控制措施後仍殘存的短缺風險——這是評估現有控制措施是否足夠的重要指標。
blocks.en: "Residual Risk" = the shortage risk that remains after risk control measures are implemented. It is an important indicator for judging whether existing controls are adequate.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Risk Priority Level 的三個維度
blocks.en: Core concept: the three dimensions of Risk Priority Level

blocks.zh: 風險優先等級（Risk Priority Level）由以下三個維度的組合決定：
blocks.en: The Risk Priority Level is determined by a combination of the following three dimensions:

blocks.zh: 治療用途與患者衝擊：產品不可及對患者的嚴重程度
blocks.en: Therapeutic use and patient impact: how severe the consequence is for patients if the product is unavailable

blocks.zh: 替代品可及性：是否有其他有效替代治療
blocks.en: Availability of alternatives: whether other effective alternative treatments exist

blocks.zh: 短缺可能性：供應中斷發生的概率評估
blocks.en: Likelihood of shortage: an assessment of the probability that a supply interruption will occur

blocks.zh: 這三個維度對應到 Section 11.0 的風險分流模型（Risk Triage Model），是整個 TR-68 方法論的核心評分機制。
blocks.en: These three dimensions map to the Risk Triage Model in Section 11.0, which is the core scoring mechanism of the whole TR-68 methodology.

blocks.zh: 請判斷以下情境是否構成 TR-68 定義下的「Meaningful Disruption」，並說明理由：
blocks.en: Decide whether each of the following scenarios constitutes a "Meaningful Disruption" under the TR-68 definition, and explain why:

blocks.zh: 某廠因計畫性設備翻修停線 2 週，已提前備有 3 個月庫存。
blocks.en: A site shuts down a line for 2 weeks for a planned equipment overhaul and has 3 months of stock prepared in advance.

blocks.zh: 某廠因 GMP 查廠缺失被 FDA 發出警告信，導致無法出口，短缺可能持續 6 個月以上。
blocks.en: A site receives an FDA warning letter for GMP inspection deficiencies and can no longer export; the shortage may last more than 6 months.

blocks.zh: 某廠因原料商漲價而暫停生產 1 個月，評估市場替代方案。
blocks.en: A site suspends production for 1 month because a raw material supplier raised prices, while it evaluates market alternatives.

blocks.zh: 2.1Abbreviations  |  縮寫對照表
blocks.en: 2.1Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 中文縮寫解說 Abbreviations Commentary
blocks.en: Abbreviations Commentary

blocks.zh: 縮寫重要性提示：MAH 的核心地位
blocks.en: Why abbreviations matter: the central role of the MAH

blocks.zh: MAH（行銷授權持有人） 是 TR-68 中最核心的角色。在歐盟法規架構下，MAH 是藥品上市許可的持有者，對藥品的品質、安全性及供應連續性負有最終責任。
blocks.en: The MAH (Marketing Authorization Holder) is the most central role in TR-68. Under the EU regulatory framework, the MAH holds the marketing authorization of the medicinal product and bears ultimate responsibility for its quality, safety and continuity of supply.

blocks.zh: 在台灣，相當於「藥品許可證持有人」，即藥廠或藥商持有衛福部食藥署核發的藥品許可證者。
blocks.en: In Taiwan, this corresponds to the "drug license holder", i.e. the pharmaceutical manufacturer or distributor holding a drug license issued by the Taiwan Food and Drug Administration (TFDA), Ministry of Health and Welfare.

blocks.zh: 關鍵縮寫：ANDA vs. NDA 對供應鏈的意涵
blocks.en: Key abbreviations: what ANDA vs. NDA mean for the supply chain

blocks.zh: NDA（新藥申請）：原廠藥（innovator drug）的上市申請，通常有更強的市場地位，但若停產則無替代品
blocks.en: NDA (New Drug Application): the marketing application for an innovator drug; it usually carries a stronger market position, but if production stops there is no alternative

blocks.zh: ANDA（簡化新藥申請）：學名藥（generic drug）的上市申請，市場上可能有多家競爭者，短缺衝擊相對較小
blocks.en: ANDA (Abbreviated New Drug Application): the marketing application for a generic drug; there may be several competitors on the market, so the impact of a shortage is relatively smaller

blocks.zh: 這一區別在評估「替代品可及性」時至關重要，直接影響 Risk Priority Level 的評分。
blocks.en: This distinction is critical when assessing "availability of alternatives" and directly affects the Risk Priority Level score.

blocks.zh: PAC（核准後變更）與藥品短缺的關聯
blocks.en: PAC (post-approval change) and drug shortage

blocks.zh: PAC（Post-Approval Change，核准後變更） 是供應鏈風險的重要觸發點。廠商在進行製造場址變更、供應商變更或製程變更時，需依法向主管機關申請 PAC，處理時間可能長達數月至數年，期間若未有適當備貨，即可能引發藥品短缺。
blocks.en: PAC (Post-Approval Change) is an important trigger point for supply chain risk. When a manufacturer changes the manufacturing site, a supplier or the process, it must apply to the authority for a PAC; processing can take months to years, and without adequate stock built up in the meantime, a drug shortage can result.

blocks.zh: TR-68 的風險框架將 PAC 管理納入預防措施的重要考量之一。
blocks.en: The TR-68 risk framework treats PAC management as one of the important considerations in preventive measures.

blocks.en: Abbreviation quiz

blocks.zh: 不查表，請嘗試回答：
blocks.en: Without looking it up, try to answer:

blocks.en: What is the abbreviation for "quality risk management"? What four core steps does it consist of?

blocks.zh: VSM 是什麼工具？它在 TR-68 中的作用是什麼？
blocks.en: What is a VSM? What is its role in TR-68?

blocks.en: EMA and FDA are the drug regulatory agencies of which two regions, respectively?

blocks.zh: 本節總結 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: TR-68 的定位：PDA 於 2014 年發布、2024 年修訂的技術指引，聚焦於藥品短缺的「預防性風險管理」，並與 ICH Q9(R1)、ICH Q12 全面對齊。
blocks.en: Positioning of TR-68: a technical report published by PDA in 2014 and revised in 2024, focused on "preventive risk management" of drug shortages and fully aligned with ICH Q9(R1) and ICH Q12.

blocks.zh: 問題嚴重性：自 2000 年代以來，全球藥品短缺日趨頻繁、嚴重且持久，根本原因是多因素的（製造品質、供應鏈全球化、法規演進、經濟因素、需求突增），需要多方利害關係人協作解決。
blocks.en: Severity of the problem: since the 2000s, global drug shortages have become more frequent, more severe and longer lasting. The root causes are multifactorial (manufacturing quality, supply chain globalization, evolving regulations, economic factors, demand surges) and require multistakeholder collaboration to solve.

blocks.zh: 監管趨勢：EMA、FDA 均已建立藥品短缺工作組與通報機制；美國法規（FD&C Act §506C）與歐盟指令（2003/94/EC 第 13 條）均要求 MAH 通報潛在短缺；早期通報已被證實有效降低短缺件數。
blocks.en: Regulatory trend: EMA and FDA have both set up drug shortage working groups and notification mechanisms; US law (FD&C Act Sec. 506C) and the EU directive (2003/94/EC Article 13) both require the MAH to notify potential shortages; early notification has been shown to reduce the number of shortages effectively.

blocks.zh: TR-68 的工具箱：提供整體風險框架、風險分流模型（Appendix 1）及藥品短缺風險登錄冊與預防應變計畫範本（Appendix 2），適用範圍從製造到「移交第一經濟客戶」。
blocks.en: The TR-68 toolbox: provides an overall risk framework, the Risk Triage Model (Appendix 1), and templates for the Drug Shortage Risk Register and Prevention & Response Plan (Appendix 2); the scope runs from manufacturing to "handover to the first economic customer".

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語：熟記 Drug Shortage、Potential Drug Shortage、Critical Shortage、Meaningful Disruption、Risk Priority Level 及 Residual Risk 的精確定義，是正確應用 TR-68 方法論的前提。
blocks.en: Key terms: memorizing the precise definitions of Drug Shortage, Potential Drug Shortage, Critical Shortage, Meaningful Disruption, Risk Priority Level and Residual Risk is a prerequisite for applying the TR-68 methodology correctly.

blocks.zh: MAH 責任：高層管理須對產品不間斷供應負責；風險基礎決策（QRM 原則）是主動預防藥品短缺的根本。
blocks.en: MAH responsibility: senior management must be accountable for uninterrupted product supply; risk-based decision making (QRM principles) is the foundation of proactive drug shortage prevention.
